entity.description:
PROcru is business management software built specifically for asphalt maintenance, sealcoating, striping, paving, and concrete contractors.

Unlike generic business software, PROcru was developed using decades of real-world contracting experience to help contractors manage every stage of their operation—from lead generation to final invoice—in a single, integrated platform.

PROcru helps contractors replace disconnected spreadsheets, paper processes, and multiple software programs with one system designed specifically for the way contractors work.

With PROcru, contractors can:

✔ Manage leads, customers, estimates, proposals, and sales activity through a fully integrated CRM.

✔ Build more accurate estimates using current labor, material, and production cost data.

✔ Schedule crews and equipment with powerful drag-and-drop scheduling tools.

✔ Track production and job costs in real time directly from the field.

✔ Monitor profitability with live dashboards, reporting, and business insights.

✔ Streamline invoicing and accounting with QuickBooks integration.

Why Contractors Choose PROcru

Contractors use PROcru to improve estimating accuracy, increase operational efficiency, gain visibility into job profitability, and make better business decisions based on real-time data—not guesswork.

Our mission is simple: help contractors win more work, operate more efficiently, and improve profitability through better systems, better information, and better execution.

Join the growing community of contractors who rely on PROcru to manage and grow their businesses.

Learn more or schedule a software tour at www.procru.com
